Q: Why does my BF code stop reading input early? A:

The brainfuck interpreter you’re using from brew install brainfuck takes only the first character in each line for input, meaning that (by default) you need to enter each character of your input on a separate line (ref: https://github.com/fabianishere/brainfuck/blob/master/src/brainfuck.c#L565).

It’s a bit of an unusual way to take input, but is likely setup this way because most BF programs do not take line-delimited input (as it would require a lot of extra logic - as you’re doing), but the default line buffering of terminal emulators would not send input to the program until a newline was entered. I’ll note here that you can usually flush partial lines to the program using Ctrl+D on a non-empty line, although this is somewhat less intuitive than just pressing Enter after each character.

You can patch the interpreter and recompile it if you don’t like this behaviour - removing the part in the linked function that flushes the input to EOL - or choose a different interpreter that behaves differently.

Q: How to do countifs in powerbi A:

Usually COUNTIFS in Excel are implemented by use of CALCULATE(<expression>,<filter1>,<filter2>…) in Power BI, for example:

CALCULATE(SUM(Table1[Column1]), FILTER(Table1, Table1[Column1] < Table1[Column2]))

Read more details here.

Q: Writing custom Shiro realm A:

You seem to have created a Realm properly but have not told the SecurityManager that it is one the realms to be used. In that way, it is just another object created in the main section of shiro.ini.

To tell Shiro's SecurityManager that it needs to use myRealm as a Realm, you need to add this to your shiro.ini:

securityManager.realms = $myRealm

Q: oracle connection String with C# using oledb A:

This issue may occur if you have multiple versions of oracle on your computer.

try these steps

  1. go to network folder of oracle and open tnsnames.ora
  2. search for the your DB name (XE in this case)
  3. this will have your data source information (EX : (DESCRIPTION =(ADDRESS_LIST =(ADDRESS = (PROTOCOL = TCP)(Host = xx.xx.xx.xx)(Port = xxxx)))(CONNECT_DATA =(SERVICE_NAME = XP))))
  4. use this in Data source field of your connection string . (EX: Data Source=(DESCRIPTION =(ADDRESS_LIST =(ADDRESS = (PROTOCOL = TCP)(Host = xx.xx.xx.xx)(Port = xxxx)))(CONNECT_DATA =(SERVICE_NAME = XP)));")

also, make sure your solution was built in anyCPU mode and make sure in App Pool enable 32 bit is true
